Is Beach Republic Koh Samui still open in 2026? | Only as a hotel. The resort in north Lamai still takes guests and has a beach café, but the beach club and pool bar have been closed since 2024, and no parties, DJs or brunches are advertised. Treat it as a place to stay, not a venue.
Does Beach Republic still do a Sunday brunch? | No. The Sunday brunch that made it famous is no longer advertised, and guest reports since 2024 say the pool bar and club side have shut. For a Sunday brunch, go to Nikki Beach in Lipa Noi (12:00–16:30) or SEEN at Avani Chaweng.
Where is Beach Republic in Lamai? | At the north end of Lamai beach, at 176/34 Moo 4, Maret (GPS 9.4729, 100.0628), about 2 km from central Lamai and 10 km (15–20 minutes) from Chaweng. Some older guides wrongly place it in south Lamai.
Can non-guests eat or drink at Beach Republic? | The hotel's Beach Café and Bar was listed in October 2026 as open daily from about 08:00 to 21:00. It is a simple hotel café rather than a club, so call +66 77 458 100 before making a special trip.
Is Beach Republic being renovated or reopening? | Guests reported areas closed and under reconstruction in 2025, and a 2026 reviewer said the hotel needs renovation. We found no official announcement of a reopening, rebrand or new beach club as of November 2026.
What is the nearest beach club to Lamai now? | The nearest open beach clubs are in Chaweng, 15–20 minutes north: ARKbar has a daily pool party from 14:00 with free entry and a 300 THB sunbed minimum spend, and CLUB SEEN at Avani Chaweng holds a Saturday pool party.
Is the beach at Beach Republic good for swimming? | Not really. The north end of Lamai is shallow and stony, and recent guests say it is often too shallow to swim at low tide. The best swimming in Lamai is in the centre of the bay, about 2 km south.
Can you watch the sunset at Beach Republic? | No. Lamai faces east, so you get sunrise, not sunset. For a sunset over the sea, go to the west coast: Lipa Noi, Taling Ngam or Nathon pier, 35–45 minutes away.
